description: Fetches question-and-answer rows for one business keyword. Run this only when Q&A evidence is needed. THE TWO PROVIDERS RETURN DIFFERENT THINGS AND YOU MUST SAY WHICH YOU HAVE. On the paid data provider these are real Google Business Profile questions and answers for a profile near `near`, and it CHARGES CREDITS. On the default free provider they are Google/Bing autocomplete completions reframed as questions — real search phrasings, but NOT anybody's Business Profile Q&A, with no answers and no asker — and NOTHING IS CHARGED. Never attribute a free-provider row to a business or quote it as a customer's question. `near` IS IGNORED ON THE FREE PROVIDER: the suggest APIs take no geography, so the same keyword returns the same rows from any coordinate. It is required because the paid provider needs it, not because the result is always localised. On the paid provider `radiusKm` is converted to metres and clamped into 200 m - 199,999 m, so a radius above about 200 km is silently reduced to that ceiling. An empty result means no Q&A was found for this phrasing; whether the business has questions elsewhere was not measured.

depth.description: Maximum Q&A rows to fetch (1-100). Defaults to 20.

keyword.description: Business name or search phrase identifying the Google Business Profile.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

near.description: Coordinate and radius to search around.

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the center, in kilometers. get_google_business_questions clamps it to roughly 0.2-200 km and ignores it entirely on the free provider — see that tool's description before reporting a radius as applied.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_google_business_questions
